entities.name: Service area list
entities.description: An information element that may be included to assign a new service area list to the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives the service area list assignment.

entities.name: Assignment condition
entities.description: Condition under which the service area list IE may be included to assign a new list to the UE.

relations.description: The inclusion of the service area list IE is guarded by the condition that it may be included for assignment.
The assignment condition establishes that a new service area list is assigned to the UE.
